content:
Donald Trump on Thursday used the second day in a row of speeches at the Republican midterm meeting in Dallas to open with a bold claim.

"Less than two years ago, the American people gave us a mandate to save America. In the 19 months since, I have delivered on every single promise I made, and I think I've delivered even more than I promised."

Watch:

Trump's claim that he has "delivered on every promise" was quickly fact-checked on social media.

Critics pointed out that he had a long list of unfulfilled promises from his 2024 campaign, including pledges to curb inflation, end Russia's war on Ukraine, and lower energy prices, among others.
